intro: HSK 4 papers taken on screen like the real internet-based test: Listening, Reading, Writing, timed per section and scored out of 300.
load_error: Couldn't load the paper. Please reload the page.

group.official_hint: Official past HSK 4 papers with listening transcripts (read by a computer voice).
group.mock_hint: Practice papers in the HSK 4 format, with audio files and answer explanations.

mode_desc.strict: Like the computer test: each listening item plays once and moves on by itself; Reading 40 min, Writing 25 min, then it moves on automatically. You can't go back to a finished section.
mode_desc.practice: No time limit, move freely between questions, replay audio as often as you like, listening questions are shown.

tts_note: This paper has no audio files; the transcript is read by your device's Chinese voice.
ime_note: Writing needs Chinese characters: turn on a Chinese (pinyin) keyboard. In sentence building you can also tap the words.

rules.listening: Each recording plays only once, then you have {{gap}} seconds to answer before the next one.
rules.reading: Answer in any order within this section. When time is up it moves on to Writing.
rules.writing: Type your sentences in Chinese characters. When time is up the paper is submitted.

confirm_section: You can't come back to this section afterwards.
audio_failed: Couldn't play this recording. Choose your best guess.
answer_window: Choose an answer · next item in {{s}} s
press_play: Press Listen to play the recording

part.listening_1: Listen and judge true or false
part.reading_1: Fill in the blank with the right word
part.writing_1: Build a sentence from the words
part.writing_2: Write a sentence about the picture using the word

order_hint: Tap the sentences in the right order.
write1_hint: Build a complete sentence from these words (tap a word to add it, or type).
write2_hint: Look at the picture and write a sentence with this word:
no_image: The source paper has no picture; write a sentence with the word
type_here: Type your answer in Chinese characters
pass_rule: HSK 4 is passed with {{pass}}/{{max}} or more. Each skill is scored out of 100.
